Hi Erin / Tom,

Great conversation yesterday — thanks for the time. Attached is a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (MAP) and a short evaluation plan that mirrors the milestones we discussed. High level:

- Pilot (4 weeks): integration + performance baseline; target latency < 300ms median for key flows
- Evaluation (weeks 5–8): quality checkpoints, 2 prompt sets, and usage patterns collection
- Ramp (months 2–3): commit to production rollouts; target 150% of pilot volume by month 3

Commercial proposal (conditional on MAP milestones):
- 6-month committed subscription with a $45,000/mo minimum commitment
- 20% one-time discount on standard hosted rates if MAP milestones (pilot + evaluation + month-3 ramp) are met and evidenced in the evaluation report
- Add a 3-month clawback / adjustment clause if ramp thresholds are not reached

I've attached: Silverline_MAP_v1.xlsx (MAP milestones & KPIs) and SOW-draft.pdf (scope + timeline). [Attachment stubs included]

If you want a deeper pricing breakout for procurement (line-item quote), I can pull that together — otherwise this is the framework we usually route through internal approvals. Happy to schedule a short call with Lena if she'd like additional detail for finance.

Next steps I suggest: you review the MAP and SOW, confirm the acceptance criteria for the pilot, and let me know whether Lena will need a formal PO or vendor packet.
